## 1. Installation  _(Chapter)_

- **Download** (`Marketplace`) — search for the extension name · install · reload the window
- **Sign in** (`Settings`) — paste the token · Cloud also needs the e-mail · *1 open question*

### Checks

| Step | Command | Expected | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Version | `code --version` | `1.82` or newer |  |
| Extension | `code --list-extensions` | the extension id |  |
